Everything you need to use Dolil Onusondhan smoothly
1. Adding a Deed Step by Step

Tap Add Deed, select the deed type and registration date, add one or more grantors and grantees, pick District → Upazila → Mouza, and add one or more land parcels. Total land area updates automatically in Shotok and Katha.
2. Smart Search in Bangla or English
Type numbers in either Bangla (১২৫৬) or English (1256). You can search by deed number, person name, Dag, Khatian, or Mouza name—even partial prefixes work.
Narrow results in Search by deed type, year, Narayanganj mouza with 10 sorting options, or filter by status and sort cleanly in Records.
Save unfinished deeds as drafts anytime, even offline. In Guest Mode, everything stays in a safe local demo sandbox on your phone and never touches live cloud records.
Dolil Onusondhan organizes your land deed information and calculations clearly, but always verify official certified records with your local Sub-Registry or AC Land office.
